name: Contest registrar
design: Tall slender adult female, ivory spotted hide, exposed narrow skull and four delicate curved mandibles, long thin dreadlocks tied high. Flowing ochre-grey wrap robe with narrow black fitted vest, long asymmetrical side panel and small bronze chest clasp. Holds a slim closed contest-registration tablet vertically against abdomen with both hands, stylus tucked at belt, calm upright stance.
